usedFor: flowyteam tracks key results, and Brevo sorts the right contacts into lists with “Add Contacts To List”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Off-Track Key Result” in flowyteam, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: An off-track key result needs attention, so the right contacts land on a list you can reach.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” only adds contacts that already exist, found by email, contact ID or external ID.
